Activate 1 (manipulate)

Fairy pies are often presented as gifts to guests and charming hosts, their variety of fillings each providing different benefits. In addition to gaining the benefits of the pie upon eating it, you must immediately attempt a @Check[will|dc:18|showDC:all] save. On a failure, you take a –1 item penalty to saves against spells and effects from fey creatures for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Fey Feast Penalty]

An apple fairy pie grants you a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws to resist sleep effects until you next make your daily preparations.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Fairy Pie (Apple)]
